entries.title: Control the tempo
entries.text: Enter turn mode when precise positioning matters. Exploration remains best for unconstrained travel.

entries.title: Make the hotbar yours
entries.text: Right-click any hotbar slot to assign an available ability or item to that hotkey.

entries.title: Plan before committing
entries.text: Turn-mode routes show their cost before commitment. Remove or cancel segments that spend more movement than intended.

entries.title: React to incoming threats
entries.text: Emergency reactions use a small temporary AP budget. Reposition, change stance, or seek cover before ending the reaction.

entries.title: Expect an uncertain landing
entries.text: A grenade can land anywhere in its displayed uncertainty region. Blast effects originate from the recorded landing point.

entries.title: Capture useful evidence
entries.text: Export a bug report after unexpected behavior to preserve the current session, journal, and guidance context.
